dedupe_keys.name: hourly wind and solar generation profiles for every eia 2020 plant in the contiguous us 1980 2022

description: This data set gives historical hourly wind and solar generation profiles for every plant in the EIA 2020 data set in the contiguous United States, for each year from 1980 to 2022. It was produced by Cameron Bracken, Scott Underwood, Allison Campbell, Travis Thurber and Nathalie Voisin with support from the GODEEEP investment at Pacific Northwest National Laboratory, with a Scientific Data paper. Profiles come from regional atmospheric climate model simulations applied to the 2020 plant configurations. Plant configuration files derived from EIA-860 2020 give each logical plant's modelling data, and yearly generation files give an 8,760-hour capacity factor per plant in UTC, to be multiplied by system capacity for megawatts. Coverage is all EIA 2020 wind and solar plants in the contiguous US, designed for aggregation to balancing authorities or production cost model nodes. Files are one ZIP of about 3 GB on Zenodo (version 1.1.1, updated November 2024) under CC0 at no cost. Caveats: plant fleets are fixed at 2020, so the series show weather variability, not historical output, and some plants were split into two logical plants. Simulation uses are reliability assessment and planning under weather variability and extremes. Related records: data-godeeep-hydro-power-system-ready-hydropower is a companion hydropower set.
